description: Your eyes come out; something better goes in. Low-light overlays and threat-tagging sharpen everything you look at.

failure_messages.burnout: One optic dims and doesn't come back up. Everything is suddenly flat on that side.
failure_messages.dead: The array goes dark. You're looking through two dead lenses and nothing else.
failure_messages.fault: Your vision tears into bands of static. You're blind for as long as it takes to be frightening.
failure_messages.strain: The overlay starts to smear at the edges, colours dragging a half-second behind what you look at.

name: Ocular Array
